title: Face operation wrongly? reports material left after operation.
body: ### What happened Got this error when doing a facing operation: generate failed: could not generate the toolpath: Face1: invalid machining parameters: two holes stand 15.15 mm apart on the row at Y=-55.50, narrower than the 3.000 mm tool: the strip between them would stay standing - use a smaller tool, or cut through the holes AI says: That error is misleading. Your selected face has six holes, and at Y=-55.50 the code measures 15.15 mm between two hole edges. A 3 mm tool is plainly narrower than that gap. The Face check in face_holes.rs (Camcraft/crates/motion/src/machining2d/face_holes.rs:135) reports an error when it finds no generated row segment between the holes. It never checks whether the measured gap is smaller than the tool. face.rs (Camcraft/crates/motion/src/machining2d/face.rs:196) then describes that result as “narrower than the tool.” So this is a bug in the rejection logic or the row clipping, not evidence that your 3 mm tool cannot fit. I haven’t changed the code yet. Worked for 1m 13s • 10:13 PM How should it be fixed ? I’ll check how the Face operation handles material left by skipped rows, so the fix addresses the toolpath as well as the incorrect error. • Explored └ Search uncut\(|narrow_gap\( in motion Read face_holes.rs, face.rs I’d fix the reason for rejecting the row, not just the wording. 1. Make narrow_gap compare the measured gap with the tool diameter. Its current “no row segment” check does not prove the gap is narrow. 2. For this project, inspect the row at Y=-55.50: compare the original hole edges, the holes expanded by the tool radius, and the generated row segments. A 15.15 mm gap with a 3 mm tool should leave room for a segment; we need to find why clipping removed it. 3. Keep the existing swept-area check. If material would still be left unfaced, report that accurately instead of generating a path that silently misses it. 4. Add a regression test using hanging.camproj, alongside the existing test that correctly rejects a genuinely too-narrow gap. Simply adding gap < tool_diameter would remove this error, but could conceal the clipping problem that caused it. https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/261 Not sure exactly how to fix this so I am leaving it. Aside: it would be helpful if the toolpath was shown even if it has errors and the error location was highlighted in a different color. ### Steps to reproduce Open this file. [cutouts.camproj.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34537211/cutouts.camproj.zip) Select a facing operation Select the face of the solid Press Generate Toolpath ### camcraft version and OS Main with all code for 0.14 build, Linux, Nvidia x86_64 ### Screenshots or recording _No response_
